description: THE TORTURED POETS DEPARTMENT?? mother really said 'here's my whole entire diary, suffer with me' and I am BEGGING for more 😭💅🏻 This album is literally just blondie reading her exes to absolute filth over synth-pop and I live for the lore. 'loml' and 'So Long, London' had me ugly crying in my car at 2am 🥹✨ It's messy, it's unhinged, it's a masterpiece, no notes.
